description: This Java class defines a MockEndpoint used for simulating device endpoints in testing, including cluster management and endpoint properties.

classes.name: MockEndpoint
classes.description: A class representing a mock device endpoint with cluster management and properties.

methods.name: MockEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs a MockEndpoint with specified parameters, initializing basic cluster.

methods.name: addCluster
methods.description: Adds a cluster to either server or client clusters based on its type.

methods.name: getServerCluster
methods.description: Retrieves a server cluster by its ID.

methods.name: getClientCluster
methods.description: Retrieves a client cluster by its ID.

methods.name: getServerClusterIds
methods.description: Returns sorted array of server cluster IDs.

methods.name: getClientClusterIds
methods.description: Returns sorted array of client cluster IDs.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of the endpoint.
